# A second bill from the same vendor, settled by the claim the first one parked
# — named the short way, with `txn_guid:` and nothing else.
#
# The payable mirror of `second_usd_invoice_takes_the_parked_credit.txt`: the
# book overpaid the vendor, so what is left over is money the vendor holds and
# owes back, and spending it on this bill is a credit being spent whether or
# not the file says so. The signs run the other way here, which is where a
# wrong one goes unnoticed.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_foreign_currency_cost_basis.py.

bill "BILL-USD-SECOND"
	vendor_id: "V-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-03-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-01
		description: "More consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Expenses:Consulting"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-01
		due: 2026-04-01
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
		memo: "Bill BILL-USD-SECOND"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-03-01
		amount: 100
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		memo: "Settled from the claim on the vendor"
